purpose: Decompose the existing cumulative 3renhuku conf40 EV10 odds-cap sweep into incremental odds segments. This diagnoses where the combined ROI is coming from and prevents the no-cap cumulative result from hiding tail losses.

source.common_rule: Candidate A and B1a agree top1; conservative top1 probability >=0.40; one consensus-top3 3renhuku ticket; conservative ticket EV >=10%; flat 100 yen.

method.note: Published sweep ROI values are rounded, so return differences are interpreted at settlement reporting precision. The >20 tail is effectively zero-return in both A and B.

no_cap_total.explanation: The +5% no-cap combined ROI is inherited from <=20x winners; the added >20x tickets contributed approximately zero return and diluted the edge.

interpretation: 20x is still not a theoretical probability boundary.
But the burned A+B evidence does not support promoting >20x to practical real-money use: in the comparable frozen rule, all 27 incremental >20x selections produced approximately zero return.
Therefore a no-hard-cap concept may remain scientifically interesting, but >20x must be treated as a separate longshot validation problem rather than assumed beneficial from EV algebra alone.
The correct next test is prospective band validation with frozen PRE probability and PRE odds, not further tuning on burned A+B.

decision.future_core_practical_rule: <=20x remains the only burned-A/B-supported practical neighborhood until new prospective evidence says otherwise

evidence_gate_for_future_promotion.anti_jackpot_requirement: must also pass longshot validation gate; one jackpot cannot establish stable edge
